title: Game Critics
summary: A videogamedunkey video essay on video game critics. It argues that a critic's taste and integrity matter as much as their score, and tries to explain why major outlets give such inflated ratings.
why: Recommended as an amusing but thoughtful take on review inflation and game journalism, in threads about reviews and ratings.

quote.text: Dunkey presented a fairly well-argued idea why major publications tend to give 9+/10 reviews to games
